verses.28:1: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the falling flower, the glory of its exultation, who were on the summit of the richest valley, going astray from wine.
verses.28:2: Look, the Lord is mighty and strong, like an onslaught of hail, a shattering whirlwind, like an onslaught of many waters overflowing and sent forth over a wide land.
verses.28:3: With feet the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trampled down.
verses.28:4: And the falling flower of the glory of its exultation, which is on the summit of the valley of the rich, will be like an early fruit before the ripeness of autumn, which, when an onlooker has gazed upon it, as soon as he holds it in his hand, he will devour it.
verses.28:5: In that day the Lord of hosts will be a crown of glory and a garland of exultation to the remnant of His people;
verses.28:6: and a spirit of judgment to the one sitting over judgment, and strength to those returning from war to the gate.
verses.28:7: But these also knew nothing because of wine, and went astray because of drunkenness; priest and prophet knew nothing because of drunkenness; they were swallowed up by wine, they went astray in drunkenness, they did not know the seer, they were ignorant of judgment.
verses.28:8: For all tables were filled with vomit and filth, so that there was no longer any place.
verses.28:9: Whom will He teach knowledge? And whom will He make to understand what is heard? Those weaned from milk, pulled away from the breasts.
verses.28:10: For command, command again; command, command again; wait, wait again; wait, wait again; a little there, a little there.
verses.28:11: For with speech of the lip and with another tongue He will speak to this people.
verses.28:12: To whom He said, "This is My rest; refresh the weary; and this is My refreshment," and they were unwilling to listen.
verses.28:13: And the word of the Lord will be to them: "Command, command again; command, command again; wait, wait again; wait, wait again; a little there, a little there," so that they may go, and fall backward, and be crushed, and be ensnared, and be captured.
verses.28:14: Because of this, hear the word of the Lord, mocking men, who rule over My people who are in Jerusalem.
verses.28:15: For you have said, "We have struck a covenant with death, and with the underworld we have made a pact; when the overflowing scourge passes through, it will not come upon us, because we have set falsehood as our hope, and by falsehood we have been protected."
verses.28:16: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Look, I will place in the foundations of Zion a stone, a tested stone, a cornerstone, precious, founded in the foundation; let the one who believes not hurry.
verses.28:17: And I will set judgment by weight, and justice by measure; and hail will overturn the hope of falsehood, and waters will overflow the protection.
verses.28:18: And your covenant with death will be blotted out, and your pact with the underworld will not stand; when the overflowing scourge passes through, you will be to it for trampling.
verses.28:19: Whenever it passes through, it will carry you away, for in the morning at daybreak it will pass through, by day and by night; and only vexation alone will give understanding to what is heard.
verses.28:20: For the bed is made so narrow that one falls off, and the short cloak cannot cover both."
verses.28:21: For just as on the mountain of divisions the Lord will stand, just as in the valley that is in Gibeon He will be angry, so that He may do His work, strange is His work; so that He may perform His work, foreign is His work from Him.
verses.28:22: And now do not mock, so that your bonds may not perhaps be tightened; for I have heard of a completion and a shortening from the Lord God of hosts, upon the whole earth.
verses.28:23: Give ear, and hear my voice; pay attention, and hear my speech.
verses.28:24: Will the one plowing plow all day in order to sow? Will he break up and hoe his soil?
verses.28:25: When he has leveled its surface, will he not sow black cumin and scatter cumin, and set wheat in rows, and barley, and millet, and vetch within its borders?
verses.28:26: And He will instruct him in judgment; his God will teach him.
verses.28:27: For black cumin will not be threshed with saws, nor will a wagon wheel go around over cumin; rather, black cumin will be beaten out with a rod, and cumin with a staff.
verses.28:28: Bread, however, will be crushed; yet the one threshing will not thresh it forever, nor will the wagon wheel bruise it, nor will he crush it with his hooves.
verses.28:29: And this has gone forth from the Lord God of hosts, so that He might make counsel wonderful and magnify justice.
verses.29:1: Woe to Ariel, Ariel, the city that David conquered! Year has been added to year; the festivals have run their course.
verses.29:2: And I will besiege Ariel with a rampart, and she will be sorrowful and mourning, and she will be to Me like Ariel.
verses.29:3: And I will encircle like a sphere all around you, and I will cast up an embankment against you, and I will set fortifications for your siege.
verses.29:4: You will be brought low; from the earth you will speak, and from the ground your speech will be heard; and your voice will be like that of a divining spirit from the earth, and from the ground your speech will mutter.
verses.29:5: And the multitude of those winnowing you will be like fine dust, and like passing ash the multitude of those who prevailed against you;
verses.29:6: and it will happen suddenly, at once. She will be visited by the Lord of hosts with thunder, and shaking of the earth, and a great voice of whirlwind and tempest, and of a flame of devouring fire.
verses.29:7: And the multitude of all the nations that fought against Ariel, and all who waged war, and besieged, and prevailed against her, will be like a dream of a night vision.
verses.29:8: And just as one who is hungry dreams, and eats, yet when he has awakened, his soul is empty; and just as one who is thirsty dreams and drinks, and after he has awakened, he is weary and still thirsty, and his soul is empty: so will be the multitude of all the nations that fought against Mount Zion.
verses.29:9: Be astounded and marvel; waver and totter; be drunk, and not from wine; stagger, and not from drunkenness.
verses.29:10: For the Lord has mixed for you a spirit of deep sleep; He will close your eyes; He will cover your prophets and your leaders, who see visions.
verses.29:11: And the vision of all will be to you like the words of a sealed book, which, when they give it to one who knows letters, they will say, "Read this," and he will answer, "I cannot, for it is sealed."
verses.29:12: And the book will be given to one who does not know letters, and it will be said to him, "Read," and he will answer, "I do not know letters."
verses.29:13: And the Lord said: "Because this people draws near with its mouth, and with its lips glorifies Me, yet its heart is far from Me, and they have feared Me through the commandment and teachings of men,
verses.29:14: therefore, look, I will proceed to cause astonishment to this people with a great and astounding wonder; for wisdom will perish from its wise ones, and the understanding of its prudent ones will be hidden."
verses.29:15: Woe to you who are deep in heart, to hide counsel from the Lord; whose works are in darkness, and they say, "Who sees us? And who knows us?"
verses.29:16: This thought of yours is perverse, as if the clay should think against the potter, and the work should say to its maker, "You did not make me," and the thing formed should say to the one who formed it, "You do not understand."
verses.29:17: Will not Lebanon, yet in a little while and in a short time, be turned into Carmel, and Carmel be reckoned as a forest?
verses.29:18: And in that day the deaf will hear the words of the book, and out of darkness and gloom the eyes of the blind will see.
verses.29:19: And the meek will increase joy in the Lord, and poor people will exult in the Holy One of Israel;
verses.29:20: for the one who was prevailing has come to an end, the mocker is finished, and all who were watching over iniquity have been cut down,
verses.29:21: who were making people sin by a word, and were tripping up the one who reproves at the gate, and turned aside in vain from the righteous one.
verses.29:22: Because of this, this is what the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, says to the house of Jacob: "Jacob will not now be put to shame, nor will his face now blush;
verses.29:23: rather, when he sees his children, the works of My hands in his midst, sanctifying My name, they will even sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will proclaim the God of Israel;
verses.29:24: and those going astray in spirit will know understanding, and the mutterers will learn the law."
verses.30:1: "Woe, deserting sons," says the Lord, "that you make a plan, and not from Me, and weave a web, and not through My Spirit, so that you add sin upon sin,
verses.30:2: who walk to go down into Egypt, and have not inquired of My mouth, hoping for help in the strength of Pharaoh, and having confidence in the shadow of Egypt!"
verses.30:3: And the strength of Pharaoh will become shame for you, and confidence in the shadow of Egypt, disgrace.
verses.30:4: For your princes were in Tanis, and your messengers reached all the way to Hanes.
verses.30:5: All were put to shame over a people that could not profit them; they were not for help or for any usefulness, but for shame and for reproach.
verses.30:6: The burden of the beasts of the south. In a land of tribulation and distress, the lioness and the lion from them, the viper and the flying basilisk; carrying their riches on the shoulders of beasts and their treasures on the hump of camels to a people that will not be able to profit them.
verses.30:7: For Egypt will help in vain and to no purpose. Therefore I cried out concerning this: "It is mere pride; be still."
verses.30:8: Now therefore go in, write for it upon boxwood, and carefully inscribe it in a book, and it will be in the last day for a testimony forever.
verses.30:9: For it is a people provoking to anger, and lying sons, sons unwilling to hear the law of God,
verses.30:10: who say to those who see, "Do not see," and to those who gaze, "Do not gaze for us at the things that are right; speak pleasing things to us; see errors for us.
verses.30:11: Take away the way from me; turn aside the path from me; let the Holy One of Israel cease from before our face."
verses.30:12: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this word, and have hoped in slander and in tumult, and have leaned upon it,
verses.30:13: therefore this iniquity will be for you like a falling breach, and sought out in a high wall, because suddenly, while it is not expected, its shattering will come.
verses.30:14: And it will be smashed to pieces just as a potter's jar is shattered with a very powerful shattering, and among its fragments there will not be found a shard in which a little fire may be carried from a burning, or a little water drawn from a pit."
verses.30:15: For this is what the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, says: "If you return and are still, you will be saved; in silence and in hope will be your strength. And you were unwilling,
verses.30:16: and you said, 'By no means, rather we will flee to horses'; therefore you will flee; and, 'We will mount upon swift ones'; therefore those who pursue you will be swifter.
verses.30:17: A thousand men before the terror of one, and before the terror of five you will flee, until you are left like the mast of a ship on the summit of a mountain, and like a signal on a hill."
verses.30:18: Therefore the Lord waits so that He may have mercy on you, and for this reason He will be exalted, sparing you, because the Lord is a God of judgment; blessed are all who wait for Him!
verses.30:19: For the people of Zion will dwell in Jerusalem; weeping, you will by no means weep; showing mercy, He will have mercy on you at the voice of your cry; as soon as He hears, He will answer you.
verses.30:20: And the Lord will give you scant bread and scarce water, and He will no longer cause your teacher to fly away from you, and your eyes will be seeing your instructor.
verses.30:21: And your ears will hear a word behind your back from one warning: "This is the way; walk in it, and do not turn aside either to the right or to the left."
verses.30:22: And you will defile the plates of the carved images of your silver, and the garment of the molten image of your gold, and you will scatter them like the uncleanness of a menstruating woman. "Get out!" you will say to it.
verses.30:23: And rain will be given to your seed wherever you sow in the earth, and the bread of the produce of the earth will be most abundant and rich; in that day the lamb will graze spaciously in your possession,
verses.30:24: and your bulls and the colts of donkeys that work the earth will eat mixed mash, just as it has been winnowed on the threshing floor.
verses.30:25: And there will be upon every high mountain and upon every uplifted hill streams of running waters, in the day of the slaughter of many, when the towers fall;
verses.30:26: and the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, like the light of seven days, in the day in which the Lord binds up the wound of His people and heals the bruise of its blow.
verses.30:27: Look, the name of the Lord comes from afar; His fury is burning and heavy to bear; His lips are filled with indignation, and His tongue is like a devouring fire.
verses.30:28: His breath is like an overflowing torrent up to the middle of the neck, to destroy the nations into nothing, and the bridle of error that was in the jaws of the peoples.
verses.30:29: You will have a song like the night of a consecrated festival, and gladness of heart like one who goes with a flute to enter into the mountain of the Lord, to the Strong One of Israel.
verses.30:30: And the Lord will make the glory of His voice heard, and He will show the terror of His arm in the threatening of fury and the flame of devouring fire; He will strike down in a whirlwind and in hailstones.
verses.30:31: For at the voice of the Lord, Assyria will be terrified, struck with the rod.
verses.30:32: And the passing of the rod will be established, which the Lord will make rest upon it with tambourines and harps; and in extraordinary battles He will vanquish them.
verses.30:33: For Topheth has been prepared since yesterday, prepared by the king, deep and widened. Its fuel is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord is like a torrent of sulfur kindling it.
verses.31:1: Woe to those who go down into Egypt for help, hoping in horses, and having confidence in chariots, because they are many, and in horsemen, because they are exceedingly strong, and have not trusted in the Holy One of Israel, and have not sought the Lord!
verses.31:2: Yet He Himself, being wise, has brought calamity, and has not taken away His words; and He will rise up against the house of the most wicked, and against the help of those who work iniquity.
verses.31:3: Egypt is man, and not God, and their horses are flesh, and not spirit; and the Lord will lower His hand, and the helper will collapse, and the one to whom help is given will fall, and together they will all be consumed.
verses.31:4: For this is what the Lord says to me: "Just as if a lion, and a young lion, roars over his prey, and when a multitude of shepherds comes against him, he will not be afraid at their voice and will not be terrified at their multitude: so the Lord of hosts will come down to do battle upon Mount Zion and upon its hill.
verses.31:5: Like flying birds, so the Lord of hosts will protect Jerusalem, protecting and delivering, passing over and saving.
verses.31:6: Turn back, just as you had withdrawn into the depths, sons of Israel.
verses.31:7: For in that day a man will cast away the idols of his silver and the idols of his gold, which your hands made for you into sin.
verses.31:8: And Assyria will fall by a sword not of a man, and a sword not of a human being will devour it; and it will flee, not from before the sword, and its young men will become tributaries.
verses.31:9: And its strength will pass away from terror, and its princes will be terrified as they flee," said the Lord, whose fire is in Zion and His furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.32:1: Look, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will preside in judgment.
verses.32:2: And a man will be like one who is hidden from the wind and conceals himself from a storm, like streams of waters in thirst, and the shadow of a jutting rock in a desert land.
verses.32:3: The eyes of those who see will not grow dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen carefully.
verses.32:4: And the heart of fools will understand knowledge, and the tongue of stammerers will speak swiftly and plainly.
verses.32:5: The one who is senseless will no longer be called a prince, nor will the deceitful man be called greater;
verses.32:6: for the fool will speak foolish things, and his heart will commit iniquity, to carry out hypocrisy, and to speak deceitfully to the Lord, and to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to take away drink from the thirsty.
verses.32:7: The instruments of the deceitful man are most wicked; for he himself has contrived designs to destroy the meek with speech of falsehood, when the poor man spoke judgment.
verses.32:8: But the prince will devise the things that are worthy of a prince, and he himself will stand over leaders.
verses.32:9: Wealthy women, rise up and hear my voice; confident daughters, receive my speech with your ears.
verses.32:10: For after days and a year, you will be troubled, confident ones; for the grape harvest is finished, the gathering will no longer come.
verses.32:11: Be astonished, wealthy ones; be troubled, confident ones; strip yourselves and be put to shame; gird your loins.
verses.32:12: Lament upon your breasts, over the desirable region, over the fruitful vineyard.
verses.32:13: Upon the soil of my people thorns and briers will come up; how much more upon all the houses of joy of the exulting city!
verses.32:14: For the house has been abandoned, the multitude of the city has been deserted, darkness and groping have come upon the caves forever, a joy of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks.
verses.32:15: Until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high, and the desert will become Carmel, and Carmel will be reckoned as a forest.
verses.32:16: And judgment will dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness will sit in Carmel.
verses.32:17: And the work of righteousness will be peace, and the service of righteousness will be silence and security forever.
verses.32:18: And my people will sit in the beauty of peace, and in tents of confidence, and in opulent rest.
verses.32:19: But hail will be in the coming down of the forest, and in humiliation the city will be humiliated.
verses.32:20: Blessed are you who sow upon all waters, sending in the foot of the ox and the donkey.
verses.33:1: Woe to you who plunder! Will you not also be plundered yourself? And you who spurn, will you not also be spurned yourself? When you have finished pillaging, you will be pillaged; when, exhausted, you have ceased to scorn, you will be scorned.
verses.33:2: Lord, have mercy on us, for we have waited for You; be our arm in the morning, and our salvation in the time of tribulation.
verses.33:3: At the voice of the angel the peoples fled, and at Your exaltation the nations were scattered.
verses.33:4: And your spoils will be gathered just as the locust is gathered, as when ditches are full of it.
verses.33:5: The Lord has been magnified, because He has dwelt on high; He has filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.33:6: And there will be faithfulness in your times: the riches of salvation are wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the Lord itself is his treasure.
verses.33:7: Look, the seers will cry aloud outside; the messengers of peace will weep bitterly.
verses.33:8: The roads have been laid waste, the one passing along the path has ceased; the treaty has been made void, he has cast aside the cities, he has had no regard for men.
verses.33:9: The land has mourned and languished; Lebanon has been put to shame and has become squalid; and Sharon has become like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel have been shaken.
verses.33:10: "Now I will rise up," says the Lord; "now I will be exalted, now I will be lifted up.
verses.33:11: You will conceive heat, you will give birth to stubble; your breath like fire will devour you.
verses.33:12: And the peoples will be like ash from a blaze; thorns gathered together will be burned up with fire.
verses.33:13: Hear, you who are far away, what I have done; and know, you who are near, My might."
verses.33:14: The sinners in Zion have been terrified; trembling has taken hold of the hypocrites. Who among you will be able to dwell with devouring fire? Who among you will dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.33:15: He who walks in righteous deeds and speaks truth, who casts away greed from extortion and shakes his hands free from every bribe, who stops up his ears so as not to hear of bloodshed and shuts his eyes so as not to see evil.
verses.33:16: This one will dwell in the heights; fortresses of rocks are his lofty place; bread has been given to him, his waters are reliable.
verses.33:17: His eyes will see the king in his beauty; they will gaze upon the land from afar.
verses.33:18: Your heart will meditate on fear: Where is the scholar? Where is the one weighing the words of the law? Where is the teacher of little children?
verses.33:19: You will not see a shameless people, a people of deep speech, so that you cannot understand the eloquence of their tongue, in whom there is no wisdom.
verses.33:20: Look, Zion, upon the city of our solemn feast: your eyes will see Jerusalem, a wealthy dwelling, a tent that can by no means be moved; nor will its pegs ever be taken away, and none of its ropes will be broken:
verses.33:21: because only there is our Lord magnificent: a place of rivers, very broad and open streams; no ship of rowers will pass through it, nor will a great trireme cross over it.
verses.33:22: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; He Himself will save us.
verses.33:23: Your ropes have been loosened, and they will not prevail; your mast will be such that you cannot spread out the banner. Then the spoils of much plunder will be divided; the lame will seize the booty.
verses.33:24: Nor will a neighbor say, "I have grown faint"; as for the people who dwell in it, iniquity will be taken away from them.
verses.34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear; and peoples, pay attention: let the earth hear, and its fullness; the world, and all its offspring.
verses.34:2: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all the nations, and fury upon their entire host; He has killed them and given them over to slaughter.
verses.34:3: Those killed among them will be cast out, and from their corpses a stench will rise; the mountains will dissolve from their blood.
verses.34:4: And all the host of the heavens will dissolve, and the heavens will be rolled up like a scroll; and all their host will fall away, just as a leaf falls from the vine and from the fig tree.
verses.34:5: For My sword has become drunk in heaven; look, it will descend upon Idumea, and upon the people of My slaughter, for judgment.
verses.34:6: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is thickened with fat, from the blood of lambs and male goats, from the blood of rams full of marrow; for there is a sacrifice of the Lord in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
verses.34:7: And the unicorns will descend with them, and the bulls with the mighty ones; their land will become drunk with blood, and their soil with the fat of the fattened ones.
verses.34:8: For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance, the year of retributions for the judgment of Zion.
verses.34:9: And its torrents will be turned into pitch, and its soil into sulfur; and its land will become burning pitch.
verses.34:10: Night and day it will not be extinguished; its smoke will rise forever; from generation to generation it will be desolate; forever and ever there will be no one passing through it.
verses.34:11: And the pelican and the hedgehog will possess it; the ibis and the raven will dwell in it; and a measuring line will be stretched over it so that it may be reduced to nothing, and a plumb line for desolation.
verses.34:12: Its nobles will not be there; rather, they will call upon a king, and all its princes will become nothing.
verses.34:13: And thorns and nettles will spring up in its houses, and briers in its fortresses; and it will be a lair of dragons and a pasture of ostriches.
verses.34:14: And demons will meet onocentaurs, and the hairy one will cry out, one to another; there the lamia has lain down and has found rest for herself.
verses.34:15: There the hedgehog has had a burrow, and has nourished its young, and has dug around, and has kept them warm in its shadow; there the kites have gathered together, one to another.
verses.34:16: Search diligently in the book of the Lord, and read: Not one of them has been missing, one has not sought another; because what proceeds from my mouth, He has commanded, and His Spirit Himself has gathered them.
verses.34:17: And He Himself has cast the lot for them, and His hand has divided it for them by measure: they will possess it forever; for generation after generation they will dwell in it.
verses.35:1: The desert and the trackless land will be glad, and the wilderness will exult, and will blossom like a lily.
verses.35:2: Sprouting, it will sprout, and it will exult, full of gladness and praising; the glory of Lebanon has been given to it, the beauty of Carmel and Sharon; they themselves will see the glory of the Lord and the beauty of our God.
verses.35:3: Strengthen the slackened hands, and make firm the weak knees.
verses.35:4: Say to the fainthearted, "Be strong, and do not fear: look, your God will bring the vengeance of retribution; God Himself will come and save you."
verses.35:5: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will stand open;
verses.35:6: then the lame one will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will be opened; because waters have broken forth in the desert, and torrents in the wilderness;
verses.35:7: and what was parched will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. In the lairs in which dragons previously dwelt, the greenness of reed and rush will spring up.
verses.35:8: And a path and a way will be there, and it will be called the Holy Way; no defiled one will pass along it, and this will be a straight way for you, so that fools will not go astray along it.
verses.35:9: No lion will be there, and no evil beast will go up along it, nor will one be found there; and those who have been freed will walk.
verses.35:10: And those redeemed by the Lord will return, and they will come to Zion with praise, and everlasting gladness upon their head; they will obtain joy and gladness, and grief and groaning will flee.
verses.36:1: And it happened in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians, went up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
verses.36:2: And the king of the Assyrians sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a heavy force; and he stood at the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road of the Fuller's Field.
verses.36:3: And Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, in charge of the records, went out to him.
verses.36:4: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Tell Hezekiah, 'This is what the great king, the king of the Assyrians, says: What is this confidence in which you trust?
verses.36:5: Or with what counsel or strength do you plan to rebel? In whom do you have confidence, that you have withdrawn from me?
verses.36:6: Look, you trust in this broken reed staff, in Egypt; if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all who trust in him.
verses.36:7: But if you answer me, "We trust in the Lord our God," is He not the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah took away, and said to Judah and Jerusalem, "Before this altar you shall worship"?
verses.36:8: And now surrender yourself to my master, the king of the Assyrians, and I will give you two thousand horses, and you will not be able on your own to supply riders for them.
verses.36:9: And how will you withstand the face of a judge of one place among the lesser servants of my master? But if you trust in Egypt, in chariots and in horsemen,
verses.36:10: and now, have I come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? The Lord said to me, "Go up against this land and destroy it."'"
verses.36:11: And Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, "Speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand; do not speak to us in Judean in the ears of the people who are on the wall."
verses.36:12: And Rabshakeh said to them, "Did my master send me to your master and to you to speak all these words, and not rather to the men who sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung and drink the urine of their feet with you?"
verses.36:13: And Rabshakeh stood and cried out with a loud voice in Judean and said, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of the Assyrians!
verses.36:14: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you, for he will not be able to rescue you.
verses.36:15: And do not let Hezekiah give you confidence in the Lord, saying, 'The Lord will certainly deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.'
verses.36:16: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of the Assyrians says: Make a blessing with me and come out to me, and eat, each one his own vine and each one his own fig tree, and drink, each one the water of his own cistern,
verses.36:17: until I come and take you away to a land that is like your land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.36:18: And do not let Hezekiah trouble you, saying, 'The Lord will deliver us.' Have the gods of the nations each delivered his own land from the hand of the king of the Assyrians?
verses.36:19: Where is the god of Hamath and Arpad? Where is the god of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
verses.36:20: Who is there among all the gods of these lands who has rescued his land from my hand, that the Lord should rescue Jerusalem from my hand?"
verses.36:21: And they kept silent and did not answer him a word. For the king had commanded, saying, "Do not answer him."
verses.36:22: And Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, in charge of the records, came in to Hezekiah with torn garments and reported to him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.37:1: And it happened, when King Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his garments and wrapped himself in sackcloth and entered the house of the Lord.
verses.37:2: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah, the son of Amoz, the prophet,
verses.37:3: and they said to him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy; for children have come up to birth, and there is no strength to give birth.
verses.37:4: Perhaps the Lord your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of the Assyrians, his master, sent to blaspheme the living God and to revile Him with the words that the Lord your God has heard; therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that is found."
verses.37:5: And the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.37:6: And Isaiah said to them, "This you shall say to your master: 'This is what the Lord says: Do not be afraid because of the words that you have heard, with which the young men of the king of the Assyrians have blasphemed Me.
verses.37:7: Look, I will give him a spirit, and he will hear a report, and he will return to his own land, and I will make him fall by the sword in his own land.'"
verses.37:8: Now Rabshakeh returned and found the king of the Assyrians fighting against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.
verses.37:9: And he heard them saying concerning Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, "He has come out to fight against you." When he heard this, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.37:10: "This you shall say to Hezekiah, king of Judah, speaking: 'Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of the Assyrians."
verses.37:11: Look, you have heard all that the kings of the Assyrians have done to all the lands, which they overthrew; and will you be able to be delivered?
verses.37:12: Did the gods of the nations rescue those whom my fathers overthrew: Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the sons of Eden who were in Telassar?
verses.37:13: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?'"
verses.37:14: And Hezekiah took the letters from the hand of the messengers and read them, and went up to the house of the Lord, and Hezekiah spread them out before the Lord;
verses.37:15: and Hezekiah prayed to the Lord, saying,
verses.37:16: "Lord of hosts, God of Israel, You who sit above the cherubim, You alone are God of all the kingdoms of the earth; You made heaven and earth.
verses.37:17: Incline Your ear, Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, Lord, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he sent to blaspheme the living God.
verses.37:18: For truly, Lord, the kings of the Assyrians have made desolate the lands and their regions,
verses.37:19: and have given their gods to the fire; for they were not gods, but the works of men's hands, wood and stone, and they crushed them.
verses.37:20: And now, Lord our God, save us from his hand, and let all the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone are the Lord."
verses.37:21: And Isaiah, the son of Amoz, sent to Hezekiah, saying, "This is what the Lord God of Israel says: Because of what you have asked Me concerning Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians,
verses.37:22: this is the word that the Lord has spoken against him: 'The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and mocked you; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head behind you.
verses.37:23: Whom have you reviled, and whom have you blasphemed? And against whom have you raised your voice and lifted up the haughtiness of your eyes? Against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.37:24: By the hand of your servants you have reviled the Lord, and you have said, "With the multitude of my chariots I have gone up the height of the mountains, the ridges of Lebanon; and I will cut down the loftiest of its cedars and its choice firs, and I will enter the height of its summit, the forest of its Carmel.
verses.37:25: I dug and drank water, and with the sole of my foot I dried up all the streams of the embankments."
verses.37:26: Have you not heard what I did for it long ago? From days of old I formed it, and now I have brought it about, and it has come to be for the uprooting of warring hills and of fortified cities.
verses.37:27: Their inhabitants, with shortened hand, trembled and were confounded. They became like the hay of the field, and the grass of the pasture, and the plant of the rooftops, which dried up before it ripened.
verses.37:28: I know your dwelling, and your going out, and your coming in, and your madness against Me.
verses.37:29: Because you raged against Me, your pride has come up into My ears. Therefore I will put a ring in your nostrils and a bridle in your lips, and I will lead you back into the way by which you came.'
verses.37:30: Now for you, this will be the sign: eat this year what grows of its own accord, and in the second year feed on fruit; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
verses.37:31: And that which has been saved of the house of Judah, and that which remains, will put forth root downward and bear fruit upward;
verses.37:32: for from Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and salvation from Mount Zion; the zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this.
verses.37:33: Therefore, this is what the Lord says concerning the king of the Assyrians: He will not enter this city, and he will not shoot an arrow there, and a shield will not seize it, and he will not throw up an embankment around it.
verses.37:34: By the way by which he came, by it he will return, and he will not enter this city, says the Lord.
verses.37:35: And I will protect this city to save it, for My sake and for the sake of David, My servant."
verses.37:36: Then the angel of the Lord went out and struck down in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred eighty-five thousand. And they rose in the morning, and look, they were all corpses of the dead.
verses.37:37: And Sennacherib, king of the Assyrians, set out and went away and returned, and lived in Nineveh.
verses.37:38: And it happened, while he was worshiping Nisroch his god in the temple, that Adrammelech and Sharezer, his sons, struck him down with the sword and fled into the land of Ararat; and Esarhaddon, his son, reigned in his place.
verses.38:1: In those days Hezekiah fell sick to the point of death; and Isaiah, son of Amoz, the prophet, came in to him and said to him, "This is what the Lord says: 'Put your house in order, because you will die, and you will not live.'"
verses.38:2: And Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to the Lord,
verses.38:3: and said, "I plead, Lord, remember, please, how I have walked before You in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done what is good in Your eyes." And Hezekiah wept with a great weeping.
verses.38:4: And the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
verses.38:5: "Go and say to Hezekiah, 'This is what the Lord God of your father David says: I have heard your prayer and have seen your tears; look, I will add fifteen years to your days,
verses.38:6: and I will rescue you and this city from the hand of the king of the Assyrians, and I will protect it.
verses.38:7: Now this will be the sign to you from the Lord that the Lord will perform this word that He has spoken:
verses.38:8: look, I will make the shadow of the lines along which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz in the sun return backward ten lines.'" And the sun went back ten lines along the steps that it had gone down.
verses.38:9: The writing of Hezekiah, king of Judah, when he had been sick and had recovered from his illness.
verses.38:10: I said in the middle of my days, "I will go to the gates of the underworld; I have sought the remainder of my years."
verses.38:11: I said, "I will not see the Lord God in the land of the living; I will look upon man no more, nor upon the inhabitant of rest."
verses.38:12: My generation has been taken away and rolled up from me like a tent of shepherds. My life has been cut short as by a weaver; while I was still beginning, He cut me down; from morning until evening You will bring me to an end.
verses.38:13: I hoped until morning; like a lion, so He crushed all my bones; from morning until evening You will bring me to an end.
verses.38:14: Like a young swallow, so I will cry out; I will meditate like a dove. My eyes have grown weak, looking up on high. Lord, I suffer violence; answer for me.
verses.38:15: What will I say, or what will He answer me, since He Himself has done it? I will recall to You all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.38:16: Lord, if life is lived like this, and in such things is the life of my spirit, You will discipline me and give me life.
verses.38:17: Look, in peace my bitterness is most bitter. Yet You have rescued my soul so that it would not perish; You have thrown all my sins behind Your back.
verses.38:18: For the underworld will not give thanks to You, nor will death praise You; those who go down into the pit will not wait for Your truth.
verses.38:19: The living, the living one himself will give thanks to You, just as I also do today; a father will make Your truth known to his children.
verses.38:20: Lord, save me! And we will sing our psalms all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
verses.38:21: And Isaiah ordered that they take a lump of figs and apply it as a poultice over the wound, so that he would be healed.
verses.38:22: And Hezekiah said, "What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord?"
verses.39:1: At that time Merodach-Baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and gifts to Hezekiah, for he had heard that he had been sick and had recovered.
verses.39:2: And Hezekiah rejoiced over them, and he showed them the storeroom of spices, and of silver, and of gold, and of fragrances, and of the finest ointment, and all the storehouses of his equipment, and everything that was found in his treasuries. There was not a thing that Hezekiah did not show them in his house and in all his dominion.
verses.39:3: Then Isaiah the prophet came in to King Hezekiah and said to him, "What did these men say, and where did they come from to you?" And Hezekiah said, "From a distant land they came to me, from Babylon."
verses.39:4: And he said, "What did they see in your house?" And Hezekiah said, "Everything that is in my house they have seen; there was not a thing that I did not show them in my treasuries."
verses.39:5: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the Lord of hosts.
verses.39:6: Look, days will come, and everything that is in your house, and what your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon; nothing will be left, says the Lord.
verses.39:7: And they will take some of your sons who will come out from you, whom you will father, and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."
verses.39:8: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, "The word of the Lord that He has spoken is good." And he said, "Only let there be peace and truth in my days!"
verses.40:1: "Take comfort, take comfort, My people," says your God.
verses.40:2: Speak to the heart of Jerusalem and call to her, because her wickedness is finished, her iniquity has been forgiven; she has received double from the hand of the Lord for all her sins.
verses.40:3: A voice of one crying out in the desert: "Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight the paths of our God in the wasteland.
verses.40:4: Every valley will be raised up, and every mountain and hill will be brought low; and what is crooked will become straight, and rough places will become level roads,
verses.40:5: and the glory of the Lord will be revealed, and all flesh will see together that the mouth of the Lord has spoken."
verses.40:6: A voice of one saying, "Cry out!" And I said, "What will I cry out?" "All flesh is grass, and all its glory is like a flower of the field.
verses.40:7: The grass has dried up, and the flower has fallen, because the breath of the Lord has blown upon it. Truly the people are grass;
verses.40:8: the grass has dried up, and the flower has fallen, but the word of our Lord remains forever."
verses.40:9: Climb up onto a high mountain, you who proclaim good news to Zion; raise your voice with strength, you who proclaim good news to Jerusalem; raise it up, do not be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, "Here is your God;
verses.40:10: look, the Lord God will come with strength, and His arm will rule; look, His reward is with Him, and His work is before Him.
verses.40:11: Like a shepherd He will feed His flock; in His arm He will gather the lambs, and lift them up in His bosom; those with young He Himself will carry."
verses.40:12: Who has measured the waters in a cupped hand, and weighed the heavens with a span? Who has weighed out the mass of the earth with three fingers, and balanced the mountains with a weight, and the hills on a scale?
verses.40:13: Who has assisted the Spirit of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor and shown Him?
verses.40:14: With whom did He take counsel, who instructed Him, and taught Him the path of justice, and educated Him in knowledge, and showed Him the way of prudence?
verses.40:15: Look, the nations are like a drop of a bucket, and have been counted like the smallest weight on a scale; look, the islands are like tiny dust.
verses.40:16: And Lebanon will not be enough for kindling, and its animals will not be enough for a burnt offering.
verses.40:17: All nations are as if they did not exist before Him, and by Him they have been counted as nothing and emptiness.
verses.40:18: To whom, then, have you made God similar? Or what image will you set for Him?
verses.40:19: Has a craftsman cast a carved image? Or has a goldsmith shaped it with gold, and a silversmith with silver plates?
verses.40:20: He has chosen strong and undecaying wood; a skilled artisan seeks how to set up an idol that will not move.
verses.40:21: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been announced to you from the beginning? Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?
verses.40:22: He who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like locusts; who stretches out the heavens like nothing, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;
verses.40:23: who renders the searchers of secrets as if they did not exist; He has made the judges of the earth like emptiness.
verses.40:24: And indeed their stock is neither planted, nor sown, nor rooted in the earth; suddenly He blew upon them, and they dried up, and a whirlwind will carry them off like stubble.
verses.40:25: "And to whom have you likened Me, and made Me equal?" says the Holy One.
verses.40:26: Lift up your eyes on high and see who created these things: He who leads out their army by number and calls them all by name; because of the abundance of His strength and might and power, not even one was left behind.
verses.40:27: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, "My way is hidden from the Lord, and my judgment has passed away from my God"?
verses.40:28: Do you not know, or have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, who created the ends of the earth; He will not faint, nor will He grow tired, nor is there any searching out of His wisdom.
verses.40:29: It is He who gives power to the weary, and to those who are not, He multiplies strength and might.
verses.40:30: Boys will faint and grow tired, and young men will fall in weakness;
verses.40:31: but those who hope in the Lord will renew strength; they will take up wings like eagles; they will run and not grow tired, they will walk and not faint.
verses.41:1: Let the islands be silent before Me, and let the nations renew their strength; let them come forward, and then let them speak; let us draw near to judgment together.
verses.41:2: Who has raised up the Righteous One from the east, called him to follow Him? He will give nations in his sight, and He will subdue kings; He will give them like dust to his sword, as stubble swept away by the wind to his bow.
verses.41:3: He will pursue them, he will pass on in peace; a path will not appear at his feet.
verses.41:4: Who has worked and done these things, calling the generations from the beginning? I am the Lord; I am the first and the last.
verses.41:5: The islands saw and were afraid; the ends of the earth were astounded; they drew near and came forward.
verses.41:6: Each one will help his neighbor, and will say to his brother, "Be strong."
verses.41:7: The coppersmith, striking with a hammer, strengthened the one who was forging at that time, saying, "It is good for soldering," and he strengthened it with nails so that it would not be moved.
verses.41:8: And you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, seed of Abraham My friend,
verses.41:9: in whom I took hold of you from the ends of the earth, and from its distant places I called you, and said to you, "You are My servant; I have chosen you and have not cast you away."
verses.41:10: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not turn aside, for I am your God; I have strengthened you, and I have helped you, and the right hand of My Righteous One has upheld you.
verses.41:11: Look, all who fight against you will be confounded and ashamed; they will be as though they did not exist, and the men who speak against you will perish.
verses.41:12: You will seek them and will not find them, the men who rebel against you; the men who wage war against you will be as though they did not exist and like destruction.
verses.41:13: For I am the Lord your God, taking hold of your hand and saying to you, "Do not fear; I have helped you."
verses.41:14: "Do not fear, worm of Jacob, you who are dead from Israel; I have helped you," says the Lord, and your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.41:15: I have made you like a new threshing wagon, having serrated teeth; you will thresh the mountains and crush them, and you will make the hills like dust.
verses.41:16: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them; and you will exult in the Lord; in the Holy One of Israel you will rejoice.
verses.41:17: The needy and the poor seek water, and there is none; their tongue has dried up with thirst. I, the Lord, will hear them; the God of Israel, I will not abandon them.
verses.41:18: I will open rivers on the sloping hills, and springs in the midst of the plains; I will turn the desert into pools of water, and the pathless land into streams of water.
verses.41:19: I will set in the wilderness the cedar, and the thorn, and the myrtle, and the olive tree; I will place in the desert the fir, the elm, and the box tree together,
verses.41:20: so that they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
verses.41:21: "Bring your case near," says the Lord; "bring it forward, if perhaps you have anything," says the King of Jacob.
verses.41:22: Let them come forward and declare to us whatever things are to come; declare the former things that were, and we will set our heart on them and know their outcome; and make known to us the things that are to come.
verses.41:23: Announce the things that are to come in the future, and we will know that you are gods; also do good or evil, if you can, and let us speak and see together.
verses.41:24: Look, you are from nothing, and your work is from that which does not exist; an abomination is the one who has chosen you.
verses.41:25: I have raised up one from the north, and he will come from the rising of the sun; he will call on My name, and he will bring magistrates like clay, and like a potter treading down the soil.
verses.41:26: Who has announced it from the outset so that we may know, and from the beginning so that we may say, "You are righteous"? There is neither anyone announcing, nor foretelling, nor hearing your words.
verses.41:27: The first will say to Zion, "Look, they are here," and to Jerusalem I will give an evangelist.
verses.41:28: And I looked, and there was not even one among these who would take counsel and, when questioned, answer a word.
verses.41:29: Look, they are all unjust, and their works are vain; their images are wind and emptiness.
verses.42:1: Here is My servant, I will uphold him; My chosen one, My soul has delighted in him; I have put My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth judgment to the nations.
verses.42:2: He will not cry out, nor will he show partiality, nor will his voice be heard outside.
verses.42:3: A cracked reed he will not crush, and smoking flax he will not extinguish; in truth he will bring out judgment.
verses.42:4: He will not be sad nor turbulent, until he sets judgment on the earth; and the islands will wait for his law.
verses.42:5: This is what the Lord God says, who creates the heavens and stretches them out; who forms the earth and the things that sprout from it; who gives breath to the people who are on it, and spirit to those who tread on it:
verses.42:6: "I, the Lord, have called you in righteousness, and taken hold of your hand, and kept you; and I have given you as a covenant of the people, as a light of the nations,
verses.42:7: so that you might open the eyes of the blind, and bring out the prisoner from confinement, from the prison house those sitting in darkness.
verses.42:8: I am the Lord, this is My name; I will not give My glory to another, nor My praise to carved images.
verses.42:9: The things that were first, look, they have come; I also announce new things; before they arise, I will make them heard to you."
verses.42:10: Sing to the Lord a new song, His praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and its fullness; islands, and their inhabitants.
verses.42:11: Let the desert and its cities be lifted up. Kedar will dwell in houses; give praise, inhabitants of the rock; from the top of the mountains they will cry out.
verses.42:12: They will ascribe glory to the Lord, and they will declare His praise in the islands.
verses.42:13: The Lord will go out like a mighty one; like a man of war He will stir up zeal; He will shout aloud and cry out; over His enemies He will show Himself strong.
verses.42:14: I have always been silent, I have kept still, I have been patient; like a woman in labor I will speak; I will scatter and swallow up together.
verses.42:15: I will make the mountains and hills desolate, and I will dry up all their grass; and I will turn the rivers into islands, and dry out the pools.
verses.42:16: And I will lead the blind on a way that they do not know, and on paths that they have not known I will make them walk; I will turn darkness before them into light, and crooked places into straight; these words I have done for them, and I have not abandoned them.
verses.42:17: They have been turned backward, let them be confounded with confusion, those who trust in a carved image, who say to a molten image, "You are our gods."
verses.42:18: You deaf, hear, and you blind, look in order to see.
verses.42:19: Who is blind, except My servant, and deaf, except the one to whom I have sent My messengers? Who is blind, except the one who has been sold? And who is blind, except the servant of the Lord?
verses.42:20: You who see many things, will you not observe them? You who have open ears, will you not hear?
verses.42:21: And the Lord willed to sanctify him, and to magnify the law, and to exalt it.
verses.42:22: But this people itself is plundered and laid waste; all of them are a snare of young men, and in prison houses they have been hidden; they have been made into prey, and there is no one who rescues; into plunder, and there is no one who says, "Restore."
verses.42:23: Who is there among you who will hear this, pay attention, and listen to what is to come?
verses.42:24: Who gave Jacob up to plunder, and Israel to those who lay waste? Was it not the Lord Himself, against whom we have sinned? And they were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they did not listen to His law.
verses.42:25: And He poured out upon him the indignation of His fury and fierce war; and He burned him all around, and he did not know; and He set him on fire, and he did not understand.
verses.43:1: And now this is what the Lord says, who creates you, Jacob, and forms you, Israel: "Do not be afraid, because I have redeemed you, and I have called you by your name; you are Mine.
verses.43:2: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and the rivers will not cover you; when you walk in the fire, you will not be burned up, and the flame will not burn in you.
verses.43:3: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I have given Egypt as your propitiation, Ethiopia and Seba for you.
verses.43:4: Since you became honorable in My eyes, and glorious, I have loved you, and I will give men for you, and peoples for your life.
verses.43:5: Do not be afraid, because I am with you; from the east I will bring your seed, and from the west I will gather you.
verses.43:6: I will say to the north, 'Give,' and to the south, 'Do not hold back: bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth.'
verses.43:7: And everyone who calls upon My name, for My glory I created him, I formed him, and I made him.
verses.43:8: Bring out the people who are blind, yet have eyes; deaf, yet they have ears.
verses.43:9: All the nations have been gathered together, and the tribes have been assembled. Who among you can declare this, and will make us hear the first things? Let them present their witnesses, let them be justified, and let them hear and say, 'It is true.'
verses.43:10: You are My witnesses," says the Lord, "and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe Me, and understand that I am He; before Me no god was formed, and after Me there will be none.
verses.43:11: I am, I am the Lord, and apart from Me there is no savior.
verses.43:12: I have declared and saved; I have made it heard, and there was no stranger among you: you are My witnesses," says the Lord, "and I am God.
verses.43:13: And from the beginning I am He, and there is no one who can rescue from My hand. I will work, and who will turn it back?"
verses.43:14: This is what the Lord, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I have brought down all the bars, and the Chaldeans boasting in their ships.
verses.43:15: I am the Lord, your Holy One, who creates Israel, your King."
verses.43:16: This is what the Lord says, who provided a way in the sea and a path in the rushing waters,
verses.43:17: who brought out chariot and horse, the army and the mighty warrior; together they fell asleep, and they will not rise again; they were crushed like flax, and they were extinguished:
verses.43:18: "Do not remember the former things, and do not look upon the things of old.
verses.43:19: Look, I am doing new things, and now they will spring up; surely you will know them: I will place a way in the desert, and rivers in the trackless waste.
verses.43:20: The beast of the field will glorify Me, the dragons and the ostriches, because I have given waters in the desert, rivers in the trackless waste, to give drink to My people, My chosen one.
verses.43:21: This people I have formed for Myself; they will recount My praise.
verses.43:22: You have not called upon Me, Jacob, nor have you labored over Me, Israel.
verses.43:23: You have not offered Me the ram of your burnt offering, and with your sacrifices you have not glorified Me; I have not made you serve with an offering, nor have I caused you labor with frankincense.
verses.43:24: You have not bought calamus for Me with silver, and with the fat of your sacrifices you have not saturated Me; yet you have made Me serve with your sins, you have caused Me labor with your iniquities.
verses.43:25: I am, I Myself am the one who blots out your iniquities for My own sake, and I will not remember your sins.
verses.43:26: Remind Me, and let us be judged together; recount whatever you have, so that you may be justified.
verses.43:27: Your first father sinned, and your interpreters have transgressed against Me;
verses.43:28: and I have profaned the holy princes; I have given Jacob to utter destruction, and Israel to reviling."
verses.44:1: "And now hear, Jacob, My servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen."
verses.44:2: This is what the Lord, who makes and forms you, your helper from the womb, says: "Do not be afraid, My servant Jacob, and most upright one, whom I have chosen.
verses.44:3: For I will pour out waters upon the thirsty one, and streams upon the dry ground; I will pour out My Spirit upon your seed, and My blessing upon your offspring;
verses.44:4: and they will sprout among the grasses, like willows beside waters flowing past.
verses.44:5: This one will say, 'I belong to the Lord,' and that one will call by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand, 'To the Lord,' and will be likened in the name of Israel."
verses.44:6: This is what the Lord, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the Lord of hosts, says: "I am the first, and I am the last, and apart from Me there is no god.
verses.44:7: Who is like Me? Let him call out and declare it, and let him lay out the order to Me from the time I established the ancient people; let them declare to them the things that are coming and the things that are to be.
verses.44:8: Do not be afraid, and do not be troubled: from that time I made you hear and I declared it; you are My witnesses. Is there a god apart from Me, or a fashioner whom I do not know?
verses.44:9: The shapers of an idol are all nothing, and their most cherished things will not profit them. They themselves are their witnesses, because they do not see and do not understand, so that they may be put to shame.
verses.44:10: Who has formed a god and cast a carved image useful for nothing?
verses.44:11: Look, all its associates will be put to shame, for the craftsmen are from among men; they will all assemble, they will stand and be terrified, and they will be put to shame together.
verses.44:12: The ironworker worked with a file; in glowing coals and with hammers he formed it, and he worked with the arm of his strength; he will grow hungry and lose strength, he will not drink water and will grow weary.
verses.44:13: The woodworker stretched out a rule, formed it with a plane, made it with squares, and rounded it with a compass, and made the image of a man, like a handsome human being dwelling in a house;
verses.44:14: he cut down cedars, he took a holm oak and an oak that had stood among the trees of the forest; he planted a pine tree, which the rain nourished:
verses.44:15: and it became a fire for men; he took from them and grew warm, and he kindled a fire and baked loaves; but from the rest he crafted a god and worshiped it; he made a carved image and bowed down before it.
verses.44:16: Half of it he burned in the fire, and with half of it he ate meat; he cooked a stew and was satisfied, and he grew warm and said, 'Aha! I have grown warm; I have seen the fire!'
verses.44:17: but the rest of it he made into a god and a carved image for himself; he bows down before it, and worships it, and pleads, saying, 'Deliver me, because you are my god!'
verses.44:18: They have not known, nor have they understood; for they have been plastered over so that their eyes may not see, and so that they may not understand with their heart.
verses.44:19: They do not reflect in their mind, nor do they know, nor do they perceive, so as to say, 'Half of it I burned in the fire, and I baked loaves over its coals; I cooked meat and ate it, and from the rest of it shall I make an idol? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?'
verses.44:20: Part of it is ashes; a foolish heart has worshiped it, and he will not deliver his own soul, nor will he say, 'Perhaps there is a lie in my right hand.'
verses.44:21: Remember these things, Jacob, and Israel, because you are My servant. I have formed you; you are My servant, Israel; do not forget Me.
verses.44:22: I have blotted out your iniquities like a cloud, and your sins like a mist; return to Me, because I have redeemed you."
verses.44:23: Give praise, heavens, because the Lord has shown mercy; shout for joy, ends of the earth; resound with praise, mountains, forest and every tree in it, because the Lord has redeemed Jacob, and Israel will glory.
verses.44:24: This is what the Lord, your Redeemer and your Fashioner from the womb, says: "I am the Lord, making all things, stretching out the heavens alone, establishing the earth, and there is no one with Me;
verses.44:25: making void the signs of diviners, and turning soothsayers into madness; turning the wise backward, and making their knowledge foolish;
verses.44:26: raising up the word of His servant, and fulfilling the counsel of His messengers; I who say to Jerusalem, 'You will be inhabited,' and to the cities of Judah, 'You will be built,' and I will raise up her waste places;
verses.44:27: who say to the deep, 'Be made desolate, and I will dry up your rivers';
verses.44:28: who say to Cyrus, 'You are My shepherd, and you will fulfill all My will'; who say to Jerusalem, 'You will be built,' and to the temple, 'You will be founded.'"
verses.45:1: This is what the Lord says to My anointed, Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped, so that I may subdue nations before his face and turn the backs of kings, and open doors before him, and the gates will not be shut:
verses.45:2: "I will go before you, and I will humble the glorious ones of the earth; I will crush bronze gates and break iron bars in pieces;
verses.45:3: and I will give you hidden treasures and the concealed things of secret places, so that you may know that I am the Lord, who calls your name, the God of Israel,
verses.45:4: for the sake of My servant Jacob, and Israel, My chosen one; and I have called you by your name; I have likened you, and you have not known Me.
verses.45:5: I am the Lord, and there is no one else; outside Me there is no god; I have girded you, and you have not known Me,
verses.45:6: so that those from the rising of the sun and those from the west may know that apart from Me there is none; I am the Lord, and there is no other,
verses.45:7: forming light and creating darkness, making peace and creating evil; I am the Lord, doing all these things.
verses.45:8: Shed dew, heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain down the Righteous One; let the earth be opened and bring forth the Savior, and let righteousness arise at the same time: I, the Lord, have created Him."
verses.45:9: Woe to the one who contradicts his molder, a potsherd from the earthen vessels of the earth! Will the clay say to its potter, "What are you making, and your work is without hands?"
verses.45:10: Woe to the one who says to a father, "What are you fathering?" and to a woman, "What are you in labor with?"
verses.45:11: This is what the Lord says, the Holy One of Israel, its fashioner: "Ask Me about things to come; concerning My sons and concerning the work of My hands, command Me.
verses.45:12: I made the earth, and I Myself created man upon it; My hands stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their host.
verses.45:13: I have raised him up for righteousness, and I will direct all his ways; he himself will build My city and will release My captives, not for a price nor for gifts," says the Lord God of hosts.
verses.45:14: This is what the Lord says: "The labor of Egypt, and the trade of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, tall men, will cross over to you and will be yours; they will walk behind you, bound in manacles they will go, and they will bow down to you and plead with you: 'Only in you is God, and there is no god apart from you.'"
verses.45:15: Truly You are a hidden God, the God of Israel, the Savior.
verses.45:16: They have been put to shame, and all of them have been humiliated; together the makers of errors have gone away into shame.
verses.45:17: Israel has been saved in the Lord with an eternal salvation; you will not be put to shame, and you will not be humiliated forever and ever.
verses.45:18: For this is what the Lord says, who creates the heavens, He who is God, forming the earth and making it, He Himself its fashioner; He did not create it in vain; He formed it to be inhabited: "I am the Lord, and there is no other.
verses.45:19: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob in vain, 'Seek Me.' I am the Lord, speaking righteousness, declaring what is right.
verses.45:20: Assemble and come, and draw near together, you who have been saved from the nations: they have no knowledge, those who lift up the wood of their carved image and pray to a god that does not save.
verses.45:21: Declare, and come, and take counsel together. Who made this heard from the beginning, foretold it from that time? Is it not I, the Lord, and there is no other god apart from Me? A righteous God and one who saves: there is none besides Me.
verses.45:22: Turn to Me, and you will be saved, all the ends of the earth, for I am God, and there is no other.
verses.45:23: By Myself I have sworn; a word of righteousness will go out from My mouth and will not return: that to Me every knee will bow, and every tongue will swear."
verses.45:24: "Therefore in the Lord," one will say, "are my acts of righteousness and dominion." To Him they will come, and all who resist Him will be put to shame.
verses.45:25: In the Lord all the offspring of Israel will be justified and will be praised.
verses.46:1: Bel has been broken in pieces, Nebo has been crushed; their images have become, for beasts and pack animals, your burdens of heavy weight to the point of weariness.
verses.46:2: They have wasted away and have been crushed together; they could not save the one carrying them, and their soul will go into captivity.
verses.46:3: Listen to Me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, who are carried from My belly, who are borne from My womb.
verses.46:4: Even to old age I am He, and even to gray hairs I will carry; I have made, and I will bear; I will carry, and I will save.
verses.46:5: To whom have you likened and equated Me, and compared Me and made Me similar?
verses.46:6: You who contribute gold from a pouch and weigh out silver on a scale, hiring a goldsmith so that he may make a god, and they fall down and worship.
verses.46:7: They carry it, bearing it on their shoulders and setting it in its place, and it will stand, and from its place it will not move; indeed, even when they cry out to it, it will not hear; from distress it will not save them.
verses.46:8: Remember this, and be put to shame; return, transgressors, to your heart.
verses.46:9: Recall the former age, for I am God, and there is no other god, nor is there any like Me,
verses.46:10: declaring from the outset the end, and from the beginning things that have not yet been done, saying, "My counsel will stand, and all My purpose will be done."
verses.46:11: Calling a bird from the east, and from a distant land the man of My purpose: I have spoken, and I will bring it about; I have created, and I will do it.
verses.46:12: Listen to Me, you hard of heart, who are far from righteousness.
verses.46:13: I have brought My righteousness near; it will not be far off, and My salvation will not delay. I will give salvation in Zion, and in Israel My glory.
verses.47:1: Come down, sit in the dust, virgin daughter Babylon; sit on the ground; there is no throne for the daughter of the Chaldeans, for no longer will you be called soft and tender.
verses.47:2: Take up the millstone and grind flour; lay bare your shame; uncover your shoulder, expose your legs, cross the rivers.
verses.47:3: Your disgrace will be exposed, and your reproach will be seen; I will take vengeance, and no man will resist Me.
verses.47:4: Our Redeemer, the Lord of hosts is His name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.47:5: Sit silent, and enter into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, for you will no longer be called mistress of kingdoms.
verses.47:6: I was angry with My people; I defiled My inheritance and gave them into your hand; you showed them no mercies; upon the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy.
verses.47:7: And you said, "Forever I will be mistress." You did not lay these things upon your heart, nor did you recall your end.
verses.47:8: And now listen to these things, you delicate one, dwelling confidently, who say in your heart, "I am, and there is no one else besides me; I will not sit as a widow, and I will not know barrenness."
verses.47:9: These two things will come to you suddenly in one day, barrenness and widowhood: all of them have come upon you because of the multitude of your sorceries and because of the extreme hardness of your enchanters.
verses.47:10: And you had confidence in your wickedness, and you said, "There is no one who sees me." Your wisdom and your knowledge, this deceived you. And you said in your heart, "I am, and besides me there is no other."
verses.47:11: Evil will come upon you, and you will not know its rising; and calamity will rush upon you which you will not be able to expiate; misery will come upon you suddenly which you will not know.
verses.47:12: Stand with your enchanters and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, if perhaps anything may profit you, or if you may be able to become stronger.
verses.47:13: You have grown faint in the multitude of your counsels. Let them stand and save you, the diviners of the heavens, who observed the stars and calculated the months, so that from them they might declare things to come for you.
verses.47:14: Look, they have become like stubble; fire has burned them up; they will not deliver their own soul from the hand of the flame; there are no glowing coals by which they may warm themselves, nor a hearth so that they may sit by it.
verses.47:15: So have they become for you, whatever things you had labored in: your merchants from your youth, each one in his own way, have wandered astray; there is no one to save you.
verses.48:1: Hear these things, house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel and have come out from the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of the Lord and remember the God of Israel, not in truth nor in righteousness.
verses.48:2: For they have been called from the holy city, and they have been firmly established upon the God of Israel: the Lord of hosts is His name.
verses.48:3: The former things I declared from then, and they went out from My mouth, and I made them heard; suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
verses.48:4: For I knew that you are hard, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your forehead is bronze.
verses.48:5: I told you beforehand from then; before they came, I made them known to you, so that you might not say, "My idols have done these things, and my carved images and cast images have commanded them."
verses.48:6: See all that you have heard; but you, have you declared them? I have made new things heard by you from then, and things have been preserved that you do not know.
verses.48:7: Now they are created, and not from then; and before this day you did not hear them, so that you may not say, "Look, I knew them."
verses.48:8: Neither did you hear, nor did you know, nor was your ear opened from then; for I know that you will surely deal treacherously, and I have called you a transgressor from the womb.
verses.48:9: For the sake of My name I will keep My fury far away, and with My praise I will bridle you, so that you may not perish.
verses.48:10: Look, I have refined you, but not like silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of poverty.
verses.48:11: For My own sake, for My own sake I will act, so that I may not be blasphemed; and I will not give My glory to another.
verses.48:12: Hear Me, Jacob, and Israel, whom I call: I am He, I am the first, and I am the last.
verses.48:13: My hand also founded the earth, and My right hand measured the heavens; I will call them, and they will stand together.
verses.48:14: Assemble, all of you, and hear: who among them has declared these things? The Lord has loved him; He will carry out His will in Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
verses.48:15: I, I have spoken, and I have called him; I have brought him, and his way has been made straight.
verses.48:16: Come near to Me and hear this: from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time before it came to be, I was there; and now the Lord God has sent Me, and His Spirit.
verses.48:17: This is what the Lord, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: "I am the Lord your God, teaching you what is beneficial, guiding you in the way in which you walk.
verses.48:18: If only you had heeded My commandments! Your peace would have become like a river, and your righteousness like the surges of the sea;
verses.48:19: and your seed would have been like the sand, and the offspring of your womb like its pebbles; its name would not have perished and would not have been worn away from before My face."
verses.48:20: Go out from Babylon, flee from the Chaldeans; with a voice of exultation declare it, make this heard, and carry it forth all the way to the ends of the earth. Say, "The Lord has redeemed His servant Jacob."
verses.48:21: They did not thirst in the desert when He led them out; He brought forth water from the rock for them, and He split the rock, and the waters flowed.
verses.48:22: "There is no peace for the ungodly," says the Lord.
verses.49:1: Hear, islands, and pay attention, peoples from afar: the Lord called me from the womb; from the belly of my mother He remembered my name.
verses.49:2: And He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He protected me, and He made me like a chosen arrow; in His quiver He hid me.
verses.49:3: And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, for in you I will glory."
verses.49:4: And I said, "I have labored for nothing; without cause and in vain I have spent my strength; therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my work is with my God."
verses.49:5: And now the Lord says, who forms me from the womb as a servant for Himself, so that I may bring Jacob back to Him, and Israel will not be gathered; and I have been glorified in the eyes of the Lord, and my God has become my strength.
verses.49:6: And He said, "It is too little that you should be a servant for Me to raise up the tribes of Jacob and to turn back the dregs of Israel; look, I have given you as a light of the nations, so that you may be My salvation all the way to the end of the earth."
verses.49:7: This is what the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, its Holy One, says to the despised soul, to the abhorred nation, to the servant of masters: "Kings will see, and princes will rise up, and they will worship because of the Lord, for He is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."
verses.49:8: This is what the Lord says: "In a favorable time I have heard you, and in the day of salvation I have helped you; and I have preserved you, and I have given you as a covenant of the people, so that you might raise up the land and possess the devastated inheritances;
verses.49:9: so that you might say to those who are bound, 'Go out,' and to those who are in darkness, 'Be revealed.' Along the ways they will feed, and on all the plains will be their pastures.
verses.49:10: They will neither hunger nor thirst, and the heat and the sun will not strike them, for He who has mercy on them will guide them, and at the springs of waters He will give them drink.
verses.49:11: And I will make all My mountains into a way, and My paths will be raised up.
verses.49:12: Look, these will come from afar, and look, those from the north and the sea, and these from the southern land."
verses.49:13: Give praise, heavens, and exult, earth; shout praise joyfully, mountains, for the Lord has comforted His people, and He will have mercy on His poor.
verses.49:14: And Zion said, "The Lord has abandoned me, and the Lord has forgotten me."
verses.49:15: Can a woman forget her infant, so that she does not have mercy on the son of her womb? Even if she should forget, I still will not forget you.
verses.49:16: Look, on My hands I have inscribed you; your walls are before My eyes always.
verses.49:17: Your builders have come; those who destroy you and lay you waste will go out from you.
